tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm near-black in dark, warm paper in light. Replaces the old --bg #111111.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar, table headers, the app frame. Replaces --surface and --bg-card.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised fills inside a card: inputs, segmented controls, icon tiles, hover rows, flat cards. Replaces --surface2.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, tooltips and the active segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card edges, table rules, list dividers, the sidebar edge. Decorative only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, step connectors, empty-state dashes and any edge that must read on bg-200.

tokens.name: border-glow
tokens.usage: Border of a highlighted card (the active step, the primary call-to-action panel). Pair with shadow-glow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, stat values and button labels on bg-000 through bg-300 (16.5:1 dark, 15.8:1 light on bg-000).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, descriptions, table cells, nav items at rest. Reads on bg-000 through bg-300 (8.9:1 dark, 6.9:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Kickers, captions, timestamps, placeholders and the Skipped status, on bg-000 through bg-200 (5.3:1 dark on bg-000, 4.7:1 on bg-200). Not for text on bg-300 in dark (4.2:1): use ink-secondary there.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill. 8.3:1 on the amber fill in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand amber as ink: kickers, active nav items, links, icon tiles, focus rings and the italic word in a title. 8.8:1 dark and 5.2:1 light on bg-000. Never as a large fill in light (use accent-fill).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent-coloured text and outlines.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button and toggle fill in both themes, always with ink-inverse on it. Replaces the cream #f5e9d3 button and the violet --accent.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind an active nav item, an icon tile, the input focus halo and the Running badge ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: The old violet accent, kept for the Running state, info notices and the debug log level. 7.6:1 dark, 6.1:1 light on bg-000. Never for calls to action.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Running badge and info notices.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed backups, healthy connections, positive deltas, the check mark on a recent-backup row. 7.2:1 dark, 4.8:1 light on bg-000. Always paired with a word or icon: success and danger are told apart by hue only (1.3:1), kept from the source.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the success badge and success notice.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed backups, error log lines, destructive buttons, negative deltas. 5.6:1 dark, 5.1:1 light on bg-000. Always with a word or icon (see success).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the error badge, error notice and destructive button.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warn log lines, degraded connections, retry notices. Orange, not amber, so it never reads as the brand colour. 7.5:1 dark, 5.1:1 light on bg-000.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the warning badge and warning notice.

tokens.name: chart-primary
tokens.usage: The main series in every chart: successful backups, storage over time. 8.8:1 dark, 3.0:1 light on bg-100 (a mark, not text).

tokens.name: chart-failed
tokens.usage: Failed series beside chart-primary. Darker, not just redder, so the two bars differ in lightness (3.7:1 dark, 5.0:1 light on bg-100).

tokens.name: chart-skipped
tokens.usage: Skipped series and inactive bars. 3.1:1 dark, 3.7:1 light on bg-100.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Dashed grid lines (3 3) behind bars and areas.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis tick labels at 11px mono. Alias of ink-muted kept separate so charts can be tuned alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 3px, on every interactive element. Solid, 8.8:1 dark and 5.2:1 light on bg-000.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the mobile sidebar drawer and modals, including the HITL confirmation dialog.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Peace of mind for everything you build.
styles.usage: Landing hero headline. Two to three lines, max 640px wide. Emphasise one phrase with an italic accent em.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Set up in minutes, back up forever.
styles.usage: Section headlines on the landing page and the dashboard page title (.page-title).

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card headlines and the mobile page title.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Nav-card titles, step titles, empty-state titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: The number in a StatCard and StatStrip. Use tabular figures via font-variant-numeric so columns line up.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Continuous backups, observability, and repository health so your code, issues, wikis and metadata are never lost.
styles.usage: Hero and section subtitles in ink-secondary, max 560px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Authorize with GitHub and select repositories to back up.
styles.usage: Default body copy, descriptions and chat messages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Set your backup frequency and retention preferences.
styles.usage: Table cells, list rows, nav items (weight 500), card descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, card titles, button labels (14px in .btn).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, deltas, legend entries and helper text in ink-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a headline (accent) and stat labels or table headers (ink-muted).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Repository names, run ids, log lines, SQL and JSON in chat.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Chart axis labels, log timestamps and nav counts.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Components use 8, 12, 16 and 24; page rhythm uses 32 and up. Matches Tailwind v4's numeric scale so utility classes and tokens agree.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a badge, delta arrow gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, between a label and its input, inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row gap, notice padding, sidebar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards, flat-card padding, table cell horizontal padding (20px).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: StatCard padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on small screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections, hero card padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of the main column.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on wide screens, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the main column.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between landing-page sections.

radius.note: Tightened from the old 8/16/28 scale. The 28px card radius is retired: at 24px padding it wasted corner space and read as a toy.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges without pill shape, checkboxes, list-row icon tiles, skeletons, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, flat cards, icon tiles, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat cards, tables, popovers, the app-preview frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero panel and full-width feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and the segmented control's outer shell.

shadow.note: Edges come from borders, not shadows. Shadows exist only for floating surfaces and the amber glow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The active segment of a segmented control, dropdown triggers.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdown menus, toasts and dialogs on bg-300.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The one highlighted card on a page (the call-to-action panel, the current step, a card on hover in the nav-card grid).

layout.note: Fixed dimensions of the app shell.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main column (.app-main) and the landing container.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar, down from 280px.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar under html[data-sidebar=collapsed].

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Landing nav bar and the mobile header.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at the default size; 32px small, 48px large.
